description: This file contains a Python script implementing a bisecting test framework for webkit tests, including classes for managing test buckets and bisecting logic, as well as a main function to run the bisect process.

classes.name: Bisector
classes.description: Performs bisecting to identify failing tests.

methods.name: Bucket.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Bucket with a list of tests.

methods.name: Bucket.size
methods.description: Returns the number of tests in the bucket.

methods.name: Bisector.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the bisector with tests and debug flag.

methods.name: Bisector.bisect
methods.description: Performs the bisecting process to find the failing test.

methods.name: Bisector.test_fails_in_isolation
methods.description: Checks if the expected failure fails in isolation.

methods.name: Bisector.verify_non_flaky
methods.description: Verifies the failure is consistent over multiple runs.

methods.name: Bisector.print_progress
methods.description: Prints current progress of the bisect.

methods.name: Bisector.split_largest_bucket
methods.description: Splits the largest test bucket for further bisecting.

methods.name: Bisector.test_bucket_list_fails
methods.description: Tests if any bucket in the list fails.

methods.name: Bisector.test_fails
methods.description: Runs the test suite and checks for failure.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and start the bisect process.
